title: Modern Flagship Smartphone
overview: High-density stacked mobile computing architecture integrating an OLED display, multilayer logic board, 4nm System-on-Chip (SoC), triple-lens camera module, and lithium pouch battery.
learningObjectives: Examine stacked multilayer PCB architecture and high-density interconnects (HDI)
Trace vapor chamber thermal dissipation paths from the 4nm SoC to the aluminum chassis
Analyze power delivery from the 3.85V lithium-ion battery through PMICs to sub-1V logic rails
Inspect the MIPI CSI-2 high-speed image sensor pipeline to the neural processing unit (NPU)

components.name: LTPO AMOLED Display Panel
components.summary: Flexible low-temperature polycrystalline oxide (LTPO) AMOLED panel with dynamic 1-120Hz variable refresh rate.
components.howItWorks: Millions of sub-pixel organic light-emitting diodes emit individual RGB light directly without requiring a backlight, covered by scratch-resistant chemically strengthened ceramic glass.
components.whyNeeded: Provides the primary interactive visual output and multi-touch capacitive digitizer interface.
keyFacts: LTPO 3.0 backplane for sub-1Hz idle power saving

components.name: Aerospace Aluminum Mid-Frame
components.summary: CNC-machined 7000-series aluminum structural unibody acting as rigid skeleton, thermal heat sink, and antenna ground plane.
components.howItWorks: Separates the display from internal electronics, resists torsional bending stresses, and absorbs drop impact energy.
components.whyNeeded: Protects fragile glass panels and dense microelectronics from flexural fracture during daily handling.
keyFacts: IP68 dust and water immersion seal perimeter

components.name: Tiered Main Logic Board (PCB)
components.summary: Stacked 10-layer substrate-like PCB (SLP) packed with micro-vias and RF shielding cans.
components.howItWorks: Routes thousands of microscopic differential traces between the processor, memory, power regulators, and wireless transceivers.
components.whyNeeded: Enables extreme component density in minimal volume through 3D stacked interposer soldering.

components.name: 4nm System-on-Chip (SoC)
components.summary: Heterogeneous application processor integrating an 8-core CPU, high-performance GPU, 16-core NPU, and 5G baseband modem.
components.howItWorks: Executes the mobile operating system, runs neural network inference, and encodes 4K/8K video using billions of nanometer transistors.
components.whyNeeded: Delivers all compute power while maintaining strict 3-watt thermal power constraints.
keyFacts: Package-on-Package (PoP) 16GB LPDDR5X RAM stacked directly on top

components.name: Copper Vapor Chamber Heat Spreader
components.summary: Ultra-thin sealed copper plate containing sintered copper capillary wick and deionized water working fluid.
components.howItWorks: Liquid water evaporates at the hot SoC contact zone, travels as vapor across the chamber, condenses on cooler regions, and returns via capillary action.
components.whyNeeded: Prevents silicon thermal throttling during intensive 3D rendering or fast battery charging.
keyFacts: Spans from CPU hotspot across aluminum mid-frame

components.name: 5000mAh Lithium-Polymer Battery
components.summary: High-density single-cell lithium-ion pouch cell with silicon-carbon anode technology.
components.howItWorks: Intercalates lithium ions between graphite/silicon anode and lithium cobalt oxide cathode during charge/discharge cycles.
components.whyNeeded: Provides DC electrical power (3.85V nominal, 19.3 Wh capacity) powering all internal subsystems for over a day of continuous use.
keyFacts: Integrated dual-MOSFET safety protection flex circuit

components.name: Triple-Lens Optical Camera Module
components.summary: Precision optical assembly featuring a 50MP wide sensor with sensor-shift OIS, ultra-wide, and periscope telephoto.
components.howItWorks: Directs photons through 7P aspherical molded plastic lenses onto quad-bayer CMOS image sensors with voice coil motor (VCM) autofocus.
components.whyNeeded: Enables professional computational photography, optical zoom, and 4K Dolby Vision HDR video recording.

components.name: X-Axis Linear Resonant Haptic Actuator
components.summary: Precision electromagnetic vibration motor providing tactile click and scroll wheel sensations.
components.howItWorks: Suspends a tungsten mass between linear leaf springs, driving it back and forth using pulsed AC electromagnetic coils at resonant frequency.
components.whyNeeded: Replaces mechanical click switches with crisp, responsive synthetic haptic feedback.
keyFacts: Sub-10ms vibration startup and braking response

components.name: USB-C Sub-Board & Port
components.summary: Bottom flex PCB assembly housing the USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C connector, primary microphone, and fast-charge routing.
components.howItWorks: Receives 20V/4A Power Delivery electricity and transfers 10 Gbps differential data lines to the main board via a flexible ribbon cable.
components.whyNeeded: Provides external wired charging, high-speed data transfer, and DisplayPort video out.

connections.label: VBAT 3.85V Main Rail
connections.description: High-amperage flex connector delivering direct battery chemical voltage into the power management integrated circuits.

connections.label: Fast Charge Power Delivery
connections.description: Step-down charge pump circuit feeding high-current DC into the battery during wired charging.

connections.label: Sub-1V Core Power Rails
connections.description: Multiphase buck converters supplying ultra-clean 0.75V to 1.05V to CPU/GPU silicon cores.

connections.label: MIPI CSI-2 High-Speed Bus
connections.description: Four differential data lanes streaming raw uncompressed pixel data at 2.5 Gbps per lane directly to the ISP.

connections.label: MIPI DSI Video Interface
connections.description: High-bandwidth differential video interface transmitting 120 FPS rendered frames with HDR metadata.

connections.label: Thermal Conduction Interface
connections.description: Phase-change thermal paste transferring CPU hotspot heat into the copper vapor chamber.

connections.label: Waveform Haptic Drive Signal
connections.description: Audio-class amplifier outputting synthetic sinusoidal drive waveforms to the linear actuator.

mechanisms.name: X-Axis Haptic Resonant Motion
mechanisms.explanation: Linear electromagnetic actuator oscillates the tungsten weight along the X-axis, generating localized tactile sensations.

assemblySteps.instruction: Insert copper vapor chamber into mid-frame recess and apply thermal graphite sheets.
Laminate flexible AMOLED display to front frame with pressure-sensitive waterproof adhesive.
Mount stacked logic board into top chassis cavity and torque grounding screws.
Press-fit camera module, install linear haptic motor, and secure bottom USB-C flex assembly.
Place 5000mAh lithium-polymer pouch battery into frame well using pull-tab adhesive strips and plug in main power flex.

experiments.title: Vapor Chamber Puncture / Thermal Overload
experiments.consequence: SoC reaches 105°C junction temperature, throttling clock frequencies by 65% to avoid silicon damage.
experiments.explanation: Without working fluid in the vapor chamber, thermal conductivity plummets from 10,000 W/(m·K) to standard copper conduction. Heat traps at the 4nm die, triggering emergency hardware thermal throttling.

experiments.title: Battery Protection Circuit Trip
experiments.consequence: Instantaneous total loss of mobile power; device resets immediately.
experiments.explanation: Mobile phones lack large reservoir capacitors. Disconnecting the battery shuts down the PMIC power tree in microseconds, halting CPU execution instantly.
